contest.name: RSGB 3.5 MHz Club Championship
contest.description: RSGB 3.5 MHz Club Championship — short evening contests on 80m, 1.5 hours each, run on Mondays/Wednesdays/Thursdays from February through July. Entrants represent RSGB Affiliated Societies; non-UK&CD stations welcome but do not contribute to Society scores. Exchange is RST + serial number starting at 1. One point per QSO; QSOs with the RSGB special station (G6XX or regional variant) are worth 5 points each. No multipliers. CW, SSB, PSK63, and RTTY sessions run on different dates within the series.

userPrompts.question: Select your section

options.label: 100W Assisted (≤100W, SSB/CW/Data — required for SSB sessions)

userPrompts.description: All SSB session entries are classed as Assisted. Multi-Operator stations are always Assisted. Self-spotting is permitted for Assisted entries (≤ once per 10 minutes, on a new frequency).

userPrompts.question: Affiliated Society category (UK&CD entrants)

options.label: Local Category (Society members operate within 80km of registered VMP)
General Category (members spread beyond 80km, or chose not to enter Local)

userPrompts.description: Affiliated Societies must register a Virtual Meeting Place (VMP) before any member's first event. Individual entries are by RSGB members or non-UK stations who don't represent a Society.

userPrompts.question: Affiliated Society name (leave blank for individual entry)
userPrompts.description: Free-text Affiliated Society name. Used in Cabrillo CLUB: header and for Society scoring.

userPrompts.question: Sent serial number (defaults to 1; auto-increments per QSO)
userPrompts.description: Starting serial number. The engine auto-increments by 1 for each subsequent QSO. Entrants will not be penalised if their sent serial numbers are logged slightly out of sequence.

received.name: EXCHr
received.description: Received serial number (log a 0 if no exchange received)

dupeChecking.description: A station may be worked once per mode (CW, SSB, PSK63, RTTY counted separately). In Datamodes events, the same station may be worked once on PSK63 and once on RTTY.

bonusStations.name: RSGB Special Station
bonusStations.note: QSOs with the RSGB special station (G6XX or regional variant — GD/GI/GJ/GM/GU/GW6XX) are worth 5 QSO points (1 base + 4 bonus). RSGB activates only one of these per session, but all 7 variants are listed defensively.

callHistory.description: Save received serial number for future lookups (mostly useful as a dupe indicator within a session)

exchangeValidation.description: Exchange is a serial number incrementing from 1. Engine accepts any digit string. Log a 0 for QSOs where no exchange was received.
